prerequisites: It is recommended that the student has previously taken the course Basic Communication Services.

learning_outcomes.text: Evaluate possible technological solutions to provide a specific service, based on initial conditions and the search for applicable regulations, recommendations, etc., and select the most appropriate one according to technical, economic and/or other criteria.
Present and adequately document the resolution of a problem, work, or project related to telecommunication systems.
Work in a team to design and evaluate the performance of multimedia and interactive services.
Take initiative to propose and evaluate alternative or novel solutions to problems arising from the design, configuration, and implementation of voice, data, multimedia, and interactive services.
Effectively communicate (in expression and comprehension), orally and in writing, the characteristics of the designed communication services.

syllabus_topics: Transport protocols and description of multimedia sessions
Scalability and evaluation of media distribution services
VoIP services in a home environment
RTC services in a corporate environment
Audio and video capture and storage
Audio and video encoding and playback
Development of a multimedia and interactive service using Git and deployment on a cloud server.

assessment_methods.method: Theory (two partial controls or global final exam)
Laboratory practices (two partial controls or global final exam)

assessment_rules: For ordinary and extraordinary calls, the final grade is calculated as 0.3 * Theory + 0.1 * Classroom Practices + 0.3 * Lab Practices + 0.3 * Teamwork. In Theory, a minimum of 5/10 is required; in Lab Practices, a minimum of 3/10 is required; in Teamwork, a minimum of 5/10 is required. If minimums are not met, the final grade will be the minimum between the calculated result and 4.5. For differentiated evaluation, the final grade is 0.3 * Theory + 0.3 * Practices + 0.4 * Individual Work, with a minimum of 5/10 in each part, otherwise, the final grade is the minimum between the calculated result and 4.5.
